description: Observed while verifying fk-aware-drop-ordering-20260717 (2026-09-17): tests/integration/tuning/test_duckdb_fk_drop_ordering.py::test_active_caller_transaction_is_preserved_without_nested_begin fails on clean develop (reproduced on primary clone @ a4599a938 and on worktree base d926d9dee, no local changes). The constraint-preserving CTAS sort for `items` fails safely and rolls back ("cannot start a transaction within a transaction"), but the caller's transaction is left aborted, so the subsequent SELECT COUNT(*) raises TransactionContext Error instead of returning (2,). Determine whether the safe-rollback path should preserve caller-transaction usability (as the test demands) or the test's expectation is wrong; possibly DuckDB version behavior skew. Run: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/integration/tuning/test_duckdb_fk_drop_ordering.py::test_active_caller_transaction_is_preserved_without_nested_begin -q -m slow -p no:cacheprovider -n 0
